product.name: MyHeritage Family Tree
product.description: An online genealogy platform for building, storing, and sharing family trees with names, dates, photos, and family stories.

product.name: MyHeritage Historical Records
product.description: A searchable genealogy database containing billions of historical records for researching ancestors, including records and newspaper articles.

product.name: MyHeritage DNA
product.description: A consumer DNA testing service that estimates ethnic origins and identifies genetic matches who may be relatives.

product.name: MyHeritage Photo Tools
product.description: A collection of online tools for restoring and transforming family photographs, including colorization, enhancement, animation, and memory-based video creation.

product.name: MyHeritage Family Tree Builder
product.description: Free genealogy software for creating and managing family trees on a desktop computer, with synchronization to the MyHeritage platform.

product.description: Automated genealogy matching services that compare a family tree with other trees and historical records to identify potential connections and sources.
